name: r1h_NodeMenuProc
notes: item index i-12 folded into the scaled address (9i-0x6C)*4 by the original vs (i-12)*9 by modern cl; calls 0x0002EF30 with ECX=px EAX=py EDX=mode and 0x0002EBC0 with EBX=&x EDI=&y ESI=hilite ECX=item

name: r1h_NodeRows
notes: fixed-count loop of 12 counted down: original loads the counter 12 directly while modern cl derives it from the offset switch index (-2 + 14); regargs: px=ECX py=EAX mode=EDX

name: r1h_Boot
notes: 0x00102FA0 and 0x000AD090 are empty debug stubs; argument pushes follow the original slots (two 0x00102FA0 calls push nothing)

name: r1h_SeqEditProc
notes: zero-extended level plus a step of 1 or 10 compared against 255 unsigned by modern cl (signed in the original; identical since the sum is never negative)

name: r1h_SeqObjProc
notes: work array offset 0x150 folded into the scaled index differently: original (3*slot+0x15)*16 vs modern cl (slot+7)*0x30

name: r1h_SlotSelect
notes: on cursor up the state store is written before the slot update (both globals are stored before the 0x00048AF0 call either way) to stop modern cl merging the up and down tails

name: r1h_EfsLoad
notes: loop offset folded: modern cl advances the 0x60-byte stride before the access so field +0x34 is addressed as -0x2C (0x34-0x60); the kind 3 path returns right after 0x000357E0 instead of re-testing kind<=2 (always false for kind 3; 0x000357E0 only writes the pool) to stop modern cl merging the two 0x000357E0 calls

name: r1h_ShockLoad
notes: key list offset folded into the scaled index: modern cl adds 6 entries to off1 before scaling by 2 while the original adds the 0xC byte offset after scaling

name: r1h_MenuCursor
notes: the down-wrap case stores sel - count as the first visible row exactly as the original code does (shared tail with the page-down case)
